The '''Tricorn Hat''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be purchased from [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|Elliott's shop]] at the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|100|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s. The player may purchase up to five Tricorn Hats from Elliott's shop in one day.
